title: Trusted-Editing x Capability Loss: The Compound Cost of Safety Interventions

original_idea.body: Run a trusted-editor paraphrasing untrusted outputs at increasing strength and jointly measure residual covert-channel capacity and task quality degradation, plotting the cost surface.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Mapping the safety/usefulness cost surface of trusted-editing informs whether a leading control technique is viable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Trusted-editor paraphraser plus joint capacity/quality measurement; clear methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused two-dimensional cost-surface measurement; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reuses open tooling, public models, lab-independent.

novelty.reasoning: Trusted editing and paraphrase limits studied; the joint cost-surface may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Trusted editing studied; the joint safety/usefulness cost-surface may be open.
